limits: Positive and negative column-substep sums can hide cancellation across interfaces. Positive/negative limited-interface sums cover only raw>upper-POST events. The remaining signed gap is not assumed to be rounding: upper POST can include inflow and a capped upper outflow can produce a negative gap. Storage residual absolute sum/max are observed float32-scale residuals, not interface-rounding bounds. Native role groups deduplicate columns; weighted role-point sums may overlap across points/roles.
